complexity.notes: The zero-padded format string correctly handles leading zeros, so no subset is missed. Bit-testing with shifts (i >> j) & 1 would avoid building an O(n) string per mask, but the asymptotic bound is unchanged.
complexity.summary: Enumerates all 2^n bitmasks, formats each index as a zero-padded n-bit binary string, and collects nums[j] wherever the j-th bit is '1'. This matches the output-size floor of n * 2^(n-1) total elements.
